data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mark is recorded in name-lists as “Warlike; dedicated to Mars”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mark expresses “Warlike; dedicated to Mars”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mark total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Latin Marcus, probably related to Mars, the Roman god of war. Its root is Latin Mars. Mark the Evangelist; the Gospel of Mark. Mark is a Latin name meaning “Warlike; dedicated to Mars”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
